name: Maple-Bacon Chicken Wings with Cucumber, Bell Pepper & Parsley Salad

ingredients.name: chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 500°F. Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with baking powder, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
907 g chicken wings, split with tips removed
2 tsp baking powder
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the chicken wings are baking, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice bacon.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until almost crispy, 3-4 minutes.

Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic. Place in a clean medium bowl along with ketchup, water, maple syrup, soy sauce, vinegar, and cornstarch. Whisk to combine a smooth slurry.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 cloves garlic
¼ cup ketchup
pure maple syrup
apple cider vinegar
2 tsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: When the bacon is almost crispy, pour slurry into the skillet, stirring constantly. Bring to a boil over high heat and cook, stirring frequently, until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes. Return sauce to the bowl and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 red bell peppers
2 English cucumbers
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper in another medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
apple cider vinegar
pure maple syrup
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and slice cucumbers crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
When the wings are done, remove from the oven. Add to the bowl with the sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings and salad between plates. Enjoy!
